title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
claim: Ponytail — a prompt/skill layer that makes coding agents ruthlessly minimal: ship the least code that works (YAGNI as a one-line install for 20+ agents).
why_good: Attacks the #1 complaint about coding agents — overengineered slop — and the pull is real: ~90k★ in six weeks, 62 contributors, an npm package, and it works across Claude Code, Cursor and the rest.
value: The wedge into agent behavior management: teams pay to enforce code-minimalism and style policy across every agent seat (org-wide config, policy packs, reports on bloat avoided).
risk: It's prompts, not software — near-zero moat. Any agent vendor can ship a 'concise mode' toggle, and skill-pack virality decays as fast as it spikes.
pick_reason: The project is too vague and resembles a concept rather than a clear, monetizable product.

zh.claim: Ponytail —— 一层让编码 agent 极简的提示/技能:只写能跑的最少代码(把 YAGNI 做成一行安装,支持 20+ 种 agent)。
zh.why_good: 正面打编码 agent 最大的痛点——过度设计的垃圾代码;而且势头是真的:六周约 9 万星、62 位贡献者、有 npm 包,Claude Code / Cursor / Codex 通吃。
zh.value: 切口是 agent 行为治理:团队为「在每个 agent 席位上统一强制极简与代码规范」付费(组织级配置、策略包、审计)。
zh.risk: 它是提示词不是软件,护城河近乎为零;任何 agent 厂商加个「简洁模式」开关就能覆盖,技能包的病毒式增长退得和涨得一样快。
